parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Requests focus when the control first appears.
parameters.label: What a screen reader calls it.
parameters.looping: Whether it runs past its ends.
parameters.autoplay: How long each slide stays, when it turns by itself.
parameters.onChanged: Told the slide it settles on.
parameters.aspect: The viewport's width over its height.
